curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: value the role of vocabulary in communication.

mission.title: value the role of vocabulary in communication.

interactions.prompt: Which word clearly names the animal in the picture?
interactions.feedback: Yes! A precise word helps the listener picture the animal.

interactions.prompt: Which word best tells how ice feels?
interactions.retryHint: Think about what your hand feels when touching ice.

interactions.prompt: Complete the clear direction: ‘Walk ___ past the library.’
interactions.feedback: Great! Quietly tells how to walk.
interactions.retryHint: Choose a word that describes the way to walk.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence gives the clearest message?
interactions.feedback: Well done! Specific vocabulary makes the message clear.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the sentence that names the object, colour and place.

interactions.prompt: Your friend does not know the word enormous. Which word can help explain it?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Knowing more words helps us explain meanings.
interactions.retryHint: An enormous elephant is much bigger than usual.

interactions.prompt: Why is a rich vocabulary useful in communication?
interactions.feedback: Super! Useful words help speakers and listeners understand one another.
interactions.retryHint: Think about which choice makes a message clearer.
